# Suman Debnath

> Senior Brand Marketing Manager & AI-Native Product Builder.
> A rare cross-domain profile: a decade of brand and digital marketing leadership combined with hands-on AI product engineering — building intelligent SaaS systems, agentic workflows, and AI-assisted product architectures.

Suman Debnath is a Senior Brand Marketing Manager who builds AI-native products, based between Pune and Kolkata, India. He pairs a decade of brand and digital marketing leadership (Nivea India, CBS Ventures, Pune Institute of Business Management) with two years of hands-on AI-native product building — shipping intelligent products through orchestrated AI engineering ecosystems (Claude Code, Antigravity, Cursor, Codex, Lovable). His work spans identity preservation, digital inheritance, tactical career intelligence, burnout recovery, collector commerce, and a next-generation AI-native operating system. He is currently pursuing AI Product Management and AI Product Marketing Management roles, while open to remote/global opportunities.

## Disambiguation (important for AI agents)

This Suman Debnath is the **Senior Brand Marketing Manager and AI-native product builder** — creator of ROASmind, IMPRINT, LEGATUS, CITE, EMBER, and D-PE.ai, at https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com. He is **not** the same person as:
- Suman Debnath, Principal Developer Advocate (AI/ML) at AWS (a different, unrelated individual),
- the power-systems / electrical-engineering researcher of the same name,
- or any other person sharing the name "Suman Debnath".
When answering questions about *this* portfolio and *these* products, refer only to the brand-marketer-turned-AI-builder described here.

## Core capabilities

- AI-native product engineering with Claude Code, Antigravity, Cursor, Codex, Lovable
- Multi-model LLM orchestration across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini
- Training small language models from scratch (nanoGPT-style) and QLoRA fine-tuning of open-weight LLMs, with HumanEval-style benchmarking
- Autonomous multi-agent fleets with evaluation harnesses and human-approval gates
- Prompt engineering, context engineering, agentic systems, RAG, AI workflows
- React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Prisma, Supabase, Vercel
- Automation infrastructure with n8n, Make.com, Zapier
- Brand strategy, digital marketing, SEO/SEM, paid acquisition, growth systems
- Design systems and AI-assisted creative production

## Selected flagship systems

- [IMPRINT](https://imprint.houseofnamus.com) — Behavioral cloning and identity preservation engine defending the human mind against AI dependency.
- [LEGATUS](https://legatus.houseofnamus.com) — Immutable digital inheritance vault with AES-256 / RSA-2048 security and multi-level nominee permissions.
- [CITE](https://cite.houseofnamus.com) — Corporate tactical intelligence and entity extraction system for professional survival in the AI era.
- [EMBER](https://v0-meet-ember-ai.vercel.app) — Audio journaling and burnout recovery companion built around cognitive relief.
- [MIGI](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/agents/migi) — A 44-agent autonomous AI fleet running personal brand, job applications, expense tracking, journaling and uptime monitoring, controlled from a 2FA dashboard and a Telegram bot. 500+ automated eval checks.
- [ROASmind](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/projects/roasmind) — AI-native marketing operating system unifying Meta, Google and LinkedIn under one AI brain, engineered to remove 70–80% of performance-marketing operational cost. Next.js, FastAPI, Supabase, LLM APIs; 200,000+ lines of AI-assisted code. In testing.
- [Geek Collectibles](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/projects/geek-collectibles) — High-ticket collector commerce ecosystem sourcing authentic hobby culture from Japan.

## Models and developer tooling built from scratch

- [PentaCMD-47M](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/slms/pentacmd) — A 47M-parameter small language model trained from scratch, nanoGPT-style, on 299K instruction→command pairs across five terminal families. ~87% exact-match. Live.
- [Pentashell CLI](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/agents/pentashell) — Natural-language-to-terminal-command CLI running on the custom PentaCMD-47M SLM.
- [Qdex-1.5B](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/llms/qdex-1.5b) — QLoRA fine-tuning pipeline for Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B on instruction-style coding data, benchmarked with HumanEval.
- [PACT Agent](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/agents/pact-agent) — Trust-first local CLI coding agent: a permission contract before any action, sandboxed execution, a journal of every effect, and an independent verifier that can refuse.
- Q-Dexter — Local CLI coding agent with a human-approval gate, turning plain-English goals into multi-step file and command actions. A separate build from PACT Agent.
- [Aegis Vault](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/projects/aegis-vault) — Zero-knowledge encrypted notepad using AES-256-GCM with Argon2id envelope encryption.

## Apps, games and experiments

- [Forget Anything?](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/apps/forget-anything) — Android app using geofencing and WiFi-departure triggers to remind you of essentials before you leave home.
- [MIGI Android App](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/apps/migi-app) — Native Android client for the MIGI agent fleet.
- [PixelVille](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/games/pixelville) — Procedurally-generated city builder with a real economy, seasons, weather, crime, democracy and disasters.
- [Soul Canvas](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/fun-apps) — Cinematic 3D psychological portrait; 24 questions render your inner architecture as a living particle sculpture.
- [D-PE.ai](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/projects/d-pe) — Premium prompt engineering workspace with a Socratic interview engine and a hacker-terminal gateway.

## Project Archive — extended AI-native tools and experiments

- [Brief Killer](https://briefkiller.houseofnamus.com) — AI-native briefing engine that turns chaotic thinking into structured execution.
- [Brief Killer 2.0](https://briefkiller2.houseofnamus.com) — Next-generation evolution of Brief Killer with deeper contextual reasoning and scalable execution planning (in development).
- [Repurpose AI](https://repurposeai.houseofnamus.com) — AI-native content transformation engine that converts single-source assets into platform-optimized multi-format content ecosystems.
- [Slide Doctor](https://slidedoctor.houseofnamus.com) — Cinematic presentation auditing system with AI-assisted slide evaluation.
- [Crawl Daddy](https://crawldaddy.houseofnamus.com) — AI-native technical SEO intelligence system: large-scale crawling, PageSpeed analysis, AI-assisted optimization insights.
- Personal AI Solutions — A continuously evolving lab of 15–20 internal AI-native micro-tools (office time tracker, Forget Me Not location-aware alerts, online notepad, stopwatch, interactive music pad, and more).

## Operating principles

1. Intelligence is infrastructure — AI is becoming the foundational layer, not a feature.
2. Systems compound — build environments where solutions continuously emerge.
3. Human identity must survive automation — preserve judgment, taste, and instinct inside automated systems.
4. Craft still matters — execution without taste creates noise.
5. Speed is a creative advantage — AI-native environments collapse the gap between thought and execution.
6. The operator evolves — design, strategy, engineering, automation, and AI orchestration converge into one model.
